assertion: The American Farm Bureau Federation said the cost of an average Thanksgiving feast for 10 will rise 6% from last year to $58.63.
speaker: AP

assertion: it's the first time since 2022 that Americans will see the price of the meal increase. The price hit a record of $64.05 in 2022.
speaker: AP

assertion: The Farm Bureau said the 16-pound turkey in its survey cost an average of $23.68 this year, up from $21.50 last year.
speaker: AP

assertion: Record turkey prices and higher fuel costs could make Thanksgiving dinner more expensive this year
speaker: AP
inaccuracy: Retail turkey in the AFBF survey ($1.48/lb) is well below 2022 ($28.96, $1.81/lb). Only USDA's wholesale hen price is a record.
independent_value: 2022 turkey $28.96 vs 2026 $23.68; USDA wholesale hen 177.0 cents/lb 2026 (Nov outlook)

assertion: Diesel prices have surged since the start of the Iran war and hit a record average of $6.53 per gallon in the U.S. in September, according to AAA.
speaker: AP
sql: SELECT report_date, price_dollars_per_gallon FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE eia_area_code='NUS' AND product_code='EPD2D' AND report_date>='2026-09-01'

assertion: On Wednesday diesel averaged $5.96 per gallon, up 58% from a year ago, AAA said.
speaker: AP
inaccuracy: Not directly confirmed; AAA Nov 16-17 were $5.999 and $5.985; EIA weekly is $5.937 vs $3.868 a year ago (+53%).
sql: SELECT report_date, price_dollars_per_gallon FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE eia_area_code='NUS' AND product_code='EPD2D' AND report_date IN ('2025-11-17','2026-11-16')

assertion: The U.S. Department of Agriculture expects the wholesale price of a whole frozen turkey hen will average a record $1.76 per pound this year, up 29% from last year.
speaker: AP
reason: A USDA estimate. ERS Oct outlook $1.76 (+29%); the Nov 17 outlook raised it to 177.0 cents (about +30% on 135.8). Record status not independently tested.
searched: USDA wholesale whole frozen turkey hen record $1.76 per pound 2026 forecast

assertion: Aldi said its feast for 10, which mirrors the Farm Bureau's menu, costs $39 this year. Walmart ... said its feast for 10 is $35.
speaker: AP
independent_value: Aldi under $39; Walmart $35 (retailer announcements via press coverage)
searched: Aldi Thanksgiving meal for 10 $39 Walmart $35 2026 Farm Bureau menu

sources.title: Aldi press release page (figures not on fetched page)

assertion: Prices for food eaten at home jumped 22% between October 2021 and October 2026, according to U.S. government data.
speaker: AP
sql: SELECT year, period, value FROM econ.food_cpi WHERE series='CUUR0000SAF11' AND year IN (2021,2026) AND period='M10'

assertion: This year, the USDA predicts prices for food eaten at home to rise 2.3%. That would be lower than the recent annual average of 2.6%.
speaker: AP
reason: A USDA forecast (estimate). ERS Food Price Outlook: 2026 food-at-home +2.3%; 2006-2025 average 2.6%.
measure: USDA food price outlook food-at-home forecast

sources.title: USDA ERS Food Price Outlook summary

assertion: Turkey production increased substantially this year, and cases have been waning, said Mark Jordan.
speaker: Mark Jordan
reason: ERS: 2026 turkey production 5,183 million lb, +7% vs 2025; HPAI cases 9 in October 2026 (359,400 birds). Waning trend not separately tested.
